wsjHeadlines.description: If you buy and hold a leveraged ETF, anything can happen.

wsjHeadlines.description: Expectations for what the Fed will do are driving the recent moves in long-term yields.

wsjHeadlines.description: There are fewer people sitting on ultracheap mortgages than you might think.

wsjHeadlines.description: Heart disease remains humanity’s top killer, yet for drugmakers and Wall Street, it is becoming one of the hardest places to make money.

wsjHeadlines.title: At Bending Spoons, the Numbers Are the Real Mind-Bender
wsjHeadlines.description: The tech roll-up relies on aggressive price hikes and bespoke metrics. Rising interest rates could crimp its growth.

wsjHeadlines.description: Truist Financial has inked a deal to sell $5.5 billion of auto loans as part of the regional bank’s decision to exit the near-prime auto lending business.

wsjHeadlines.title: U.S. Sanctions Russian Bank in Latest Target for Campaign Against Iran
wsjHeadlines.description: The Treasury put additional sanctions on Russia’s VTB Bank, in a bid to pressure foreign banks to cut ties with the institution.

wsjHeadlines.title: How PayPal’s CEO Is Planning to Go It Alone and Fix the Payments Giant
wsjHeadlines.description: A $50 billion buyout is stalled but Enrique Lores could make a $25 million bonus if Wall Street buys into his plans to transform the payments company.

wsjHeadlines.description: Flights and hotels are now customary expenses, in addition to gifts. But invitations aren’t obligations.

wsjHeadlines.description: Markets were largely calm ahead of the Fed‘s 2 p.m. ET policy announcement.

wsjHeadlines.description: A bill backed by Sen. Warren and Rep. Ocasio-Cortez would close ‘loopholes’ firms use to control physician practices.

wsjHeadlines.description: The investment manager aims to overhaul target-date funds with more options for employers.

wsjHeadlines.title: Databricks Piles Investments Into Asia as Growth Accelerates
wsjHeadlines.description: Analytics and artificial-intelligence software firm Databricks says its business in Asia is accelerating and plans to invest more in Singapore to tap regional demand.

wsjHeadlines.title: European Indexes Rise as Banks, AI Stocks Recover
wsjHeadlines.description: European stock indexes were in green across the board, as banks and AI-linked stocks recouped some of the week’s losses.

wsjHeadlines.description: Crude prices declined, but remained near multimonth highs.

wsjHeadlines.description: U.S. stocks fell ahead of the Federal Reserve’s rate decision as Treasury yields hit more multiyear highs amid signs of a prolonged oil shock.

wsjHeadlines.title: Stocks Decline as 10-Year Treasury Yield Hovers Near 5%
wsjHeadlines.description: U.S. stocks declined, with the Dow industrials leading modest declines.

wsjHeadlines.title: European Chip Stocks Mixed After Monday Rout
wsjHeadlines.description: Shares of European semiconductor companies were mixed after calls for a slowdown in the development of advanced artificial-intelligence models.

wsjHeadlines.title: Opinion | A Flawed Model That Burdens Small Banks
wsjHeadlines.description: The current expected credit losses accounting standard forces banks to predict future economic outcomes and drains resources.

wsjHeadlines.description: The agency’s justification for doubling its long-term bond purchases is flawed.

wsjHeadlines.title: Opinion | Don’t Tax the Unicorns
wsjHeadlines.description: New research shows how much tax policy matters to innovation.

wsjHeadlines.description: Fighting poverty and funding climate action aren’t opposites. They’re linked.

wsjHeadlines.title: Opinion | Wall Street’s Recovery From 9/11
wsjHeadlines.description: When the market reopened on Sept. 17, 2001, it told the world that terrorism wouldn’t paralyze us.

wsjHeadlines.title: Opinion | The SEC Unmuzzles Jamie Dimon
wsjHeadlines.description: The agency rescinds an Obama-era rule that limited political speech.

wsjHeadlines.title: Gold Futures Hold Gains Ahead of Fed Decision

wsjHeadlines.description: Find insight on gold, Newmont, Nippon Steel and more in the latest Market Talks covering Basic Materials.

wsjHeadlines.title: U.S. Crude Oil Stockpiles Post Moderate Draw
wsjHeadlines.description: U.S. crude oil inventories fell for a third consecutive week while gasoline and distillate stocks saw increases.

wsjHeadlines.title: U.S. Natural Gas Futures Extend Gains
wsjHeadlines.description: U.S. natural gas futures gained for a third session with warmer-for-longer weather keeping up power-sector demand.

wsjHeadlines.title: Oil Futures Pull Back From 4-Month Highs
wsjHeadlines.description: Oil futures gave back some ground after rising to their highest level since May on wider threats to shipping and energy facilities in the Middle East.

wsjHeadlines.title: Dollar Unlikely to Fall Materially if Fed Dampens Rate-Rise Bets
wsjHeadlines.description: The dollar edged higher. The Fed could dampen rate-rise expectations in its decision, although any dollar selloff is likely to prove limited, Rabobank’s Jane Foley said.

wsjHeadlines.title: Eyes on Fed Decision After Bitcoin Trades Near 4-Week Low on Failed Clarity Vote
wsjHeadlines.description: Bitcoin traded at $75,877 in afternoon European trade, after falling around 4% a day earlier to as low as $75,026. A Fed rate hike could further weigh on cryptocurrencies.
